# Brain Connectivity Based on EEG of Student Learning Processes Using Gen-AI

This dataset a collection of electroencephalogram (EEG) data recorded from 15 subjects (8 males and 7 females) with age ranging from 21 - 23 years. This dataset is recorded from the subject while doing the task by writing the essay to assess cognitive conditions, such as creativity, memory, and critical thinking. To assess cognitive activity, participants were assigned an essay-writing task under different AI interaction conditions.
